initialInvoice.description: When the initial invoice should get generated. INITIAL_COMPLETION = when the initial service is completed. SIGNED_AGREEMENT = when the agreement is signed. INITIAL_BILLING_DATE = on a specified billing date.

initialQuote.description: The retail quoted price for the initial service on this subscription.

initialServiceTotal.description: The net amount of initialQuote-initialDiscount. DOES NOT INCLUDE add-ons

initialStatus.description: A shortcut for the status of the initial appointment

initialStatusText.description: Friendly text version of the initialStatus

lastAppointment.description: Last completed appointment associated with the subscription

lastCompleted.description: When the last service was completed

leadAssignedTo.description: EmployeeID to whom the lead is assigned

leadDateAdded.description: Time that this lead was created

leadUpdated.description: Time that this lead was last updated

maxMonthlyCharge.description: Max monthly charge for the subscription

nextBillingDate.description: Next billing date for the subscription

nextService.description: When the next service is due.

officeID.description: Office ID which this subscription belongs to

parentID.description: The subscriptionID of the service plan that the service round belongs to

recurringCharge.description: A shortcut for the subtotal of the recurring ticket

recurringTicket.description: The recurring ticket template associated with this subscription

renewalFrequency.description: How often a subscription is due for renewal.

seasonalEnd.description: Date the season ends or 0000-00-00 if it is not a seasonal subscription

seasonalStart.description: Date the season starts or 0000-00-00 if it is not a seasonal subscription

sentriconConnected.description: Set as 1 if the subscription is connected to sentricon

sentriconSiteID.description: Sentricon Site ID or null if not connected to Sentricon

serviceID.description: The service type ID for the regular recurring services

soldBy.description: The employee ID who gets credit for this sale. Defaults to the user who added the subscription

soldBy2.description: Additional employeeID that gets credit for this sale

soldBy3.description: Additional employeeID that gets credit for this sale

templateType.description: The template type associated with the service type

unitIDs.description: An array of unit IDs available for this subscription (for multi unit customers) - defaults to all unless specific units have been selected

yifDiscount.description: The discount provided if paying for a year in advance

assignedTo.description: EmployeeID the task is assigned to

customerID.description: customerID the task is related to

dateAdded.description: Time the task or alert was added.

dateUpdated.description: Time the task was last updated.

dueDate.description: Time the task or alert is due.

officeID.description: officeID of the task

phone.description: Phone number associated with the task

referenceID.description: ReferenceID for the task. (e.g. subscriptionID that it relates to)

officeID.description: Office ID this team belongs to

active.description: 0: pending, 1: active and counts towards customer's outstanding balance, -1: a ticket template.

appointmentID.description: If this ticket is attached to an appointment it will show here

autoGenerated.description: The subscription ID that generated this ticket when it was part of recurring billing, from a renewal or for the initial service if the initial invoice does not get generated at the time of service completion.

autoGeneratedType.description:
Indicates if the invoice was create as part of the recurring billing schedule, for a subscription renewal or is the initial invoice when the initial invoice is not created at the time of service completion.
                    INITIAL = initial invoice, RECURRING = recurring billing invoice, RENEWAL = renewal invoice.

balance.description: Any unpaid balance left on this ticket

billToAccountID.description: Billing Account which this subscription belongs to

customerID.description: Customer ID which this subscription belongs to

dateCreated.description: Date this ticket was added / created.

dateUpdated.description: The date the ticket was updated

items.description: An array of line items associated with this ticket

officeID.description: Office ID which this subscription belongs to

productionValue.description: Value for reporting / commission purposes. -1: Same as subTotal, >= 0: different from subtotal

renewalID.description: The subscription ID that generated this ticket when it was part of a renewal

serviceTaxable.description: Whether or not the base service charge for this ticket is taxable (1) or not (0)

subTotal.description: Subtotal = serviceCharge + sum of line items

subscriptionID.description: ONLY CONTAINS A VALUE WHEN THIS IS A TEMPLATE for a particular subscription. These should never be active

taxRate.description: The tax rate associated with this ticket.

templateType.description: The ticket template type. I: initial ticket template, R: recurring ticket template, NA: not a ticket template.

dateCreated.description: Date this ticketItem was added / created.

dateUpdated.description: The date the ticketItem was updated

officeID.description: office ID

clockCategoryID.description: Clock category ID that was used for this entry

employeeID.description: EmployeeID time clock entry applied to

officeID.description: officeID the time clock entry was made on

paid.description: 0 - time clock category is specified as unpaid, 1 - time clock category is specified as paid. If time clock category is specified as 0 or does not exist it is considered a paid entry.

allowOnClockIn.description: time clock category is allowed on initial clock in.

dateUpdated.description: Date this category was last changed

description.description: Description associated with the clock category

paid.description: 0 for unpaid categories, 1 for paid categories. Clock entries with no category association are considered paid.

systemReserved.description: 1 = system reserved category (cannot be deleted or changed)
